speaker: Abu Noor
text: So. Ten at night, and I was still in Baghdad.

speaker: Guest, then Abu Noor
text: And then you died? / No. That is not how it went.

speaker: Child, then Abu Noor
text: Then how are you HERE? / ...Good question. Again.

speaker: Driver
text: Fourth gear! Tell them about fourth gear!

speaker: Uncle
text: All night? At your age? In that car?

speaker: Aunt
text: Drink your tea before it goes cold.

speaker: Old woman
text: God keep you, my son. Not so fast.

speaker: Newsreader
text: Traffic police are out on the southern road tonight.

speaker: Noor, then Abu Noor
text: They say one hand doesn't clap. / No. But it drives.
